scope: Job Discovery only; isolated actual planner, merger, commit, report expansion and upstream read-only fixture code
failures: New plans still require external company, culture or market research, or cannot persist JD-only low-score and hard-excluded evaluations
Disabled research accepts copied external research, null placeholders or unsupported Research citations
Missing salary/culture facts become supported evidence, alter eligibility, or disappear from confidence questions
JD-only commit or expansion invents an external research section or loses JD work authorization evidence
Historical research-enabled assignment omits research or one of compensation/culture/company checks, including below-threshold evaluations
Research belongs to another exact posting or employer
Missing searches, missing tool evidence reference, unsafe URL, duplicate source ids, impossible timestamps or sources not opened
A complete check has no applicable sources; compensation completion lacks a market benchmark
A report cites an unknown source, the wrong research dimension, or a quote absent from its captured source
Unavailable or limited research is presented as supported evidence or silently omitted from confidence questions
Search failures are mistaken for bad culture, low compensation or a suspicious company
A primary-provider quota failure or an independent fallback result disappears during merge, commit or expansion
Research disappears during merge, commit, report repair or expansion; raw and final results diverge
Explicit read-only v8 inspection rejects frozen rules after a policy upgrade or claims those rules match live files
Historical inspection relaxes candidate content/path checks, rule snapshot shape, research checks, or current planner/merger validation
Historical inspection modifies assignments, parts, finals, receipt, or Career-Ops data
Historical v8 reports acquire research retroactively; Career-Ops source or shared dependencies change
acceptance: Saved CLI outputs, assertions, fictional source captures and rendered Markdown in a unique .local artifact directory; no production reports or candidate files written
